p: when they came nigh to Jerusalem: A graphic image of the spiritual kingdom of Christ on earth.
Blessed is he that cometh in: Let it be well to him that comes to us from God, or that is sent from God.
Blessed be the kingdom of our: Happy and prosperous.
And seeing a fig tree afar: An example of that vengeance which hangs over the heads of hypocrites.

And they come to Jerusalem: Christ shows that he is indeed the true King and high Priest, and therefore the one who takes revenge upon those who do not show proper reverence for the holy function of the temple.
vessel through the temple: That is, any profane instrument (of which those men had many) that made the court of the temple a marketplace.
called of all nations the house: Will openly be considered and taken to be so.
And in the morning: The power of faith is exceedingly great, and charity is always joined with it.
faith in God: The faith of God is that assured faith and trust which we have in him.
ye receive them: Literally, "that you receive it", speaking in the present tense, to show the certainty of the thing, and that it will indeed be performed.
ye stand praying: When you will appear before the altar.
And they come again to Jerusalem: The gospel has been assaulted long since then by those in positions of human authority.
But if we shall say: The reward of their evil conscience is to be afraid of those who should have been afraid of them.
